templates.why_chosen: A star exemplar of the frameless two-panel variant: colour alone (green Offline Stage, blue Online Execution) divides the two halves, packing 15 components and 13 flows, well above the template's median of 11 and 5.
templates.what_to_learn: Skip the dividing rule: give each stage its own fill colour (green offline, blue online) so the two-panel split reads from colour alone, and use dashed arrows only for the feedback edges (Kernel Info back to the Profiler).
